subject: general
question: If (3, 2) are coordinates of the centroid of a triangle, whose vertices are (0, 4), (-2, 0) and (p, 2), then find the value of p.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **x-coordinate of the centroid** is the average of the **x-coordinates of the vertices**.

Sum of x-coordinates = 3 × Centroid x-coordinate

⇒ 0 + (−2) + p = 3 × 3

⇒ p − 2 = 9

⇒ p = 11

**∴ The correct answer is 11.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Vertices of the triangle are A(0, 4), B(−2, 0), and C(p, 2). The **centroid** G is (3, 2).

**Formula Used:** The coordinates of the centroid G(x, y) of a triangle with vertices (x₁, y₁), (x₂, y₂), and (x₃, y₃) are given by:

x = (x₁ + x₂ + x₃) ÷ 3

y = (y₁ + y₂ + y₃) ÷ 3

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fdd65cb360087255be7be0b649668e1e40af47bc8d732645f5f7e7f1e78638e7.png] 

**Calculations:**

For the **x-coordinate**:

⇒ 3 = (0 + (−2) + p) ÷ 3

⇒ 3 × 3 = −2 + p

⇒ 9 = p − 2

⇒ p = 9 + 2

⇒ p = 11

For the **y-coordinate** (Verification):

⇒ 2 = (4 + 0 + 2) ÷ 3

⇒ 2 = 6 ÷ 3

⇒ 2 = 2 (LHS = RHS)

**∴ The correct answer is 11.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Centroid Definition

The **centroid** is the point of intersection of the three **medians** of a triangle (lines joining vertices to the midpoints of opposite sides).

Centroid Ratio Property

The centroid divides each median in the ratio **2 : 1**, with the larger part being closer to the vertex.

Area of Triangle (Coordinates)

Area = 1/2 |x₁(y₂ − y₃) + x₂(y₃ − y₁) + x₃(y₁ − y₂)|. This formula helps find the **area** using vertex coordinates.</p
